# Vendored fixtures — inbound contract material

Signed artifacts produced by ANOTHER repo, copied here so the proof runs
without a sibling checkout. Never edit: regenerate by re-copying from source.

The point of vendoring THESE rather than generating equivalents is that a
fixture written on this side agrees with whatever this side expected. Proving
against a producer's own bytes is the only version of the test that can fail.
